title: Refundable Working Mother's Child Relief Top-up for Middle-income Working Mothers Who Have Reached Personal Income Tax Relief Cap
what_it_is: Refundable Working Mother's Child Relief Top-up for Middle-income Working Mothers Who Have Reached Personal Income Tax Relief Cap

sections.label: Personal income tax relief cap
sections.summary: The Member's suggestion targets higher-income working mothers, and the $80,000 personal income tax relief cap was introduced to make personal income tax more progressive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office and Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Member's suggestion is targeted at higher-income working mothers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office and Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The $80,000 personal income tax relief cap was introduced to make our personal income tax system more progressive.

sections.label: SG Child Support Package
sections.summary: The Government announced a new SG Child Support Package providing around $70,000 in direct financial support per Singaporean child, with Workgroup recommendations published in early 2027.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office and Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: At this year's National Day Rally, the Government announced a new SG Child Support Package which, taken together with the existing benefits, will provide around $70,000 in direct financial support for every Singaporean child.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office and Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Marriage and Parenthood Reset Workgroup's full set of recommendations will be published in early 2027.

sections.label: Working Mother's Child Relief cap
sections.summary: About eight in 10 claiming the Working Mother's Child Relief can claim it fully, and total reliefs were limited to $80,000 from year of assessment 2018.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Because amongst those currently claiming the Working Mother's Child Relief, about eight in 10 can claim it fully without being affected by the cap.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And for mothers with more children, about seven in 10 individuals claiming the Working Mother's Child Relief on two or three children, are in fact, not affected by the cap.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, after studying the pattern of reliefs claimed, we decided to limit the total reliefs that one can claim to $80,000 from the year of assessment 2018, because the relief cap does not affect about 98% of tax resident individuals.

sections.label: Baby Gift and child benefits
sections.summary: All mothers, including middle-income and higher-income ones, will get the $10,000 Baby Gift, $2,000 credits per child per year, and other benefits.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And you can see that in the recent package that was announced at the National Day Rally.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, now all mothers, not just the low-income, but also the middle-income ones and the higher-income ones, will get the $10,000 Baby Gift, the $2,000 credits per child per year, the Child Development Account First Step Grant, the co-matching, the $10 top-up to the Post-Secondary Education Account, as well as the existing benefits like the MediSave Grant for Newborns, of $5,000.
